data.description: Typed block payload. Plain-text fields are rendered literally, so markdown syntax written into one reaches the reader as raw characters — a heading of "**Title**" publishes with the asterisks showing. Only the fields listed as markdown are parsed. A markdown field also requires editor_mode alongside it: "rich" for prose the visual editor can handle, "source" for tables or raw HTML.
